summary.text: José Giral is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 180 since December 1, 2022 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jose Giral graduated from W.H. Maxwell Career and Technical High School in 1989.
He succeeded Democrat Angel Cruz in the seat in December 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Aging and Older Adult Services, Human Services, Labor and Industry, and Liquor Control committees.
